what: On first open, a large image (614px, fruit and logo) at the screen center over a white curtain swells to 1.3× after .45s and vanishes in .4s (ease-in-out). Inside it, pieces (small icons before the list lines) emerge transparent and at .45× from .32 of the image radius, turn from −150° → 0° along a sideways-curved arc out to the screen’s scatter spots (6 on desktop, 6 on phone), grow (up to 150px), then settle into place — 2s, each piece .04s later (from .3s), with the four original curves at the .08·.34·.62 intervals. Once all have landed, the curtain lifts in .6s and is removed .45s later. Scrolling is locked meanwhile. It is skipped when returning with the back button.

options.burst-delay: Delay before the big image bursts (ms), default 450
options.burst-dur: Duration of the big image bursting in (ms), default 400
options.--fx-burst-w: Big image width (via style), default 614px (440 below 992px · 300 below 768 · 220 below 480)
options.[data-fx-part=slice]: Pieces placed in position — they settle while keeping their own transform (tilt, flip)

from.where: index.html .hero (a big peach bursts and four pieces fly to the icon spots in front of the service list and settle)
